mentions.name: Clippy Vision
mentions.description: Clippy Vision is a fully local screen watcher that continuously monitors the screen and builds context over time, so users don't have to re-explain context to AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT. It currently runs a reactive ReAct loop that retrieves data from memory to answer questions, using Ollama with a local vision model and SQLite for storage, with nothing leaving the machine. A planned skill layer will make it proactive, e.g. spotting code mistakes the user may have missed or performing 'when you see X do Y' actions. Version 1 is released with source code available.
mentions.problem: Users have to repeatedly re-explain context to AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am currently working on Clippy Vision, which is a fully local screen watcher that watches your screen continuously and builds context over time so you don't have to re-explain context like you do have to in case of Claude or ChatGPT.
